Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14130443/assets/36c1ce5342657231cd78154ab4821a6a5bf9b78b74297ae5a4cdccdc2f6d5dcd.svg)
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\, A-\lambda I\mathbin{:}$
﻿﻿﻿![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14130443/assets/1cab5be2ed7c560a3a5192473be4ff7b6cf6dc5728552f1d179c73affebefe20.svg)

Then, the characteristic equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 4 \\ 3 & 2-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (2-\lambda )(2-\lambda )-4\cdot 3 & =0 \\ 4-4\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}-12 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}-4\lambda -8 & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
